title: ?author= filter is exact case-insensitive match, not substring
evidence: bookapi/store.py:60 uses `WHERE author = ? COLLATE NOCASE`; tests/test_store.py:48 confirms `store.list("Le Guin")` returns [] for author "Ursula K. Le Guin"
suggestion: Spec only requires an ?author= filter (satisfied). A LIKE/substring match would be more forgiving if partial-name search is desired.

title: PUT /books/{id} is a full replace requiring title+author
evidence: bookapi/http_app.py:129 _update_book calls _validated_body(); validation.py requires title and author, so a partial PUT without them returns 400 (tests/test_api.py:126)
suggestion: Standard PUT replace semantics satisfy the spec. If partial updates are wanted, add PATCH or merge-with-existing semantics.

title: year validation constrains range to 1..next-year beyond spec
suggestion: Spec does not require year bounds; this is extra validation. Fine, but note it rejects otherwise-parseable years outside the window.
